answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Lapidary carved cameo seal witnessed by the mine register flips the bet — each carved cameo is a measured facet angle plus a guild signature, so a farm must cut a hundred real stones by hand — and the signal lands on the attacker instead. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the wander of those crossings is a bill no payout covers. The lagoon is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
